summary.name: Numi
summary.one_liner: Numi is a text-based calculator app for Mac that lets you type calculations in natural language.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Numi as a beautiful text calculator for Mac. It is listed in the awesome-mac directory under General Tools as a freeware calculator app. The page says it supports the interface languages English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Traditional Chinese and Korean. The page text does not describe specific calculation features in detail.
notable: Available in multiple languages including English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Русский, 繁體中文, 한국어
caveats: Page text does not state download size, version or system requirements beyond Mac
Usage is subject to an end user license agreement
